Name: Keep In Touch
Author: Itivuttakam
Description:
[size=6]简介
[/size]
[size=3]在星露谷没日没夜打拼几年后，我突然意识到农夫本人极其单薄。
他的背景、他的过往好像从来都不存在，好像他只是从下了巴士开始才有了生命。
父母的信件有也少得可怜，于是我决定通过信件来略微增强一下农夫本人的立体感和完整度。

农夫以前在城市里生活，在Joja工作，他有自己的朋友，有自己的经历。
所以，这些信件会来自于他的朋友（各种朋友）、他的同事、他的工作等等。

模组共添加信件25封，指定时间14封（第一、二年），达成条件11封（收入、技能、完成度）。
内容有长有短，重在连接感，而不是真的补完农夫的过去（那样无法让每个人代入）。

会有少量的随信附件，可以说几乎不影响游戏平衡，该怎么穷还怎么穷。[/size]

[size=3]推荐从第一年春1开始使用此模组，中途添加会出现几封信堆在一起的情况，要是无所谓也无妨。

[/size][size=6]Introduction

[/size][size=3]After working day and night in Stardew Valley for several years (in the game), I suddenly realized that the farmers himself was a bit blank.
His background, his past, seemed never to exist, as if he had come to live after getting off the bus.
There are letters from parents, but the number was small. So I decided to add mails to make farmer more lively.

The farmer once lived in the city and worked in Joja. He had his own friends and experiences.
Therefore, these letters will come from his friends (various friends), his colleagues, his work, etc.

A total of 24 letters have been added to the module, 14 letters depend on time, and 10  depend on conditions.
There are long and short letters, and the important thing is * a sense of connection *, so there is no specific name or something.

It is recommended to start using this mod from year 1 spring 1. If not, mails would be piled up in a day. If you don't mind, then that's okay.[/size][size=3]

[/size][size=6]中文/English[/size]
